option_group_qty_ck.name: option_group_qty_ck
option_group_qty_ck.value:
("option_group"."quantity_min" is null and "option_group"."quantity_max" is null)
        or ("option_group"."kind" = 'quantity' and "option_group"."quantity_min" <= "option_group"."quantity_max")

product_season_ck.name: product_season_ck
product_season_ck.value:
("product"."seasonal_starts_on" is null and "product"."seasonal_ends_on" is null)
        or ("product"."seasonal_starts_on" is not null and "product"."seasonal_ends_on" >= "product"."seasonal_starts_on")

promotion_link_ck.name: promotion_link_ck
promotion_link_ck.value:
("promotion"."link_kind" = 'category') = ("promotion"."link_category" is not null)
        and ("promotion"."link_kind" = 'product' or "promotion"."link_product_id" is null)

promotion_product_discount_ck.name: promotion_product_discount_ck
promotion_product_discount_ck.value:
("promotion_product"."discount_kind" = 'percent' and "promotion_product"."percent_off" between 1 and 99 and "promotion_product"."sale_price_rs" is null)
        or ("promotion_product"."discount_kind" = 'sale_price' and "promotion_product"."sale_price_rs" >= 0 and "promotion_product"."percent_off" is null)

custom_request_quote_ck.name: custom_request_quote_ck
custom_request_quote_ck.value:
("custom_request"."quote_amount_rs" is null and "custom_request"."quote_expires_on" is null)
        or ("custom_request"."quote_amount_rs" >= 0 and "custom_request"."quote_expires_on" is not null)

orders_paid_ck.name: orders_paid_ck
orders_paid_ck.value: "orders"."paid" or ("orders"."paid_at" is null and "orders"."paid_by" is null)
